title: Add the ability to initialize the cache (and orchestrate its refreshment)
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Hello,

This is a suggestion for adding feature to initialize the cache (and orchestrate its refreshment).

Here's one of my current needs: I have an application with lots of pages. For each page, there are several cached functions that take a few minutes to execute but have a relatively long ttl (several days). The problem is that the user experience is degraded for the first user to access a page.

What would be nice, I think, is to be able to run all pages in the background (without rendering) to initialize the cache, or to be able to run a function or a page in the background (with different query params), and to be able to empty and refill the cache from time to time.

### Why?

_No response_

### How?

_No response_

_No response_
